)

SELECT count(b.id) as nums FROM ( SELECT s.id FROM gc_subject s LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission uap ON uap.must_subject_json::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.id::integer) LEFT JOIN gc_user_access ua ON UA.ID = UAP.USER_ACCESS_ID LEFT JOIN gc_user u ON u.id = ua.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_subject_complete co ON s.id = co.subject_id AND co.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_file f ON s.sub_img_id = f.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND ua.master_id = #{masterId} AND ua.role_json::jsonb @> to_jsonb('groupMember'::text) AND s.state = 1 AND s.level = 0 AND uap.id IS NOT NULL AND (co.id IS NULL OR co.subject_state = 0) AND (co.subject_state != 1 OR co.subject_state IS NULL) GROUP BY s.id ) as b
select s.id from gc_subject s where (s.available_type = 1 or s.available_type = 3) and s.master_id = #{masterId} and s.state = 1 and s.level = 0
select s.id from gc_subject s where s.available_type = 4 and s."level" = 0 and s.state = 1 and s.master_id = #{masterId}
